lines.text: I’ve been doing this for years
Once upon a time I had a fleet of machines making enough food for an entire city
Over time, the soil kept getting worse, so the company kept getting better tools, and fertiliser, and equipment to keep up
The kinda stuff that beats the soil into submission
It didn’t buy them much time, the company went bankrupt, and anything working was sold off
Now I just repair what I can find, and grow what I can
They'll keep you fed, but they also give nutrients to the soil
You can use them to repair the soil after, letting you plant some heftier crops after
Their roots don't grow far, so you'll need to cycle where you plant them to be effective
Any organic matter you want to get rid of, fill up the bin
It’ll work better if you turn the big every day
Keep an eye out for any worms you find, and add them to the bin too
